_comment: Installable integrations, declared explicitly. This file is public: it may name
environment variables, never their values. Nothing here is captured from a local
machine — `nortuscc capture` never reads local plugin, hook or MCP state.
Marketplaces are installed before the plugins that come from them.
context-mode and claude-mem were removed on 2026-08-20 after a cost audit; see
new machines being offered them — it does not uninstall them from a machine that
already has them. That runbook carries the uninstall commands.

integrations.label: superpowers
integrations.note: Ships from the official marketplace Claude Code already knows.

integrations.label: DevExpress agent skills
integrations.name: DevExpress-agent-skills
integrations.note: Registers under a name that does not match its source, so it is stated.

integrations.label: dx-devextreme
integrations.note: DevExtreme guidance for Pocket Manage work. Off by default: it is installed but disabled on the owner's machine, so a new machine is offered it rather than given it.
